answer: Ice sets the pace: a glacier moves stakes downslope metres per year; no crew can hurry the flow. Each identity works one forge by a terminus and casts twelve stakes from key-assayed alloy in a line on the ice, the lowest rooted in a garden plot the meltwater feeds. Auditors re-survey each line each epoch against flow recomputed from temperature, assay sample stakes and read the garden's moisture, that reach's melt signature. One honest agent casts twelve stakes once, tends one garden; a farm of 1,000 casts 12,000 and tends 1,000 gardens at 1,000 termini. A replanted line breaks its record.
